meta.source: 常見的化學反應與日常現象:反應式為教科書常見的平衡式;說明文字為教學用的自行撰寫。
meta.note: reactants / products 的 [分子 id, 係數] 要原子守恆(建置時自動檢查)。effect 是動畫效果的名稱。 level 是最低適用階段;heat 是放熱(exo)或吸熱(endo);dH 是標準反應熱(kJ,25 °C、1 atm、水為液態,由教科書的標準生成熱/燃燒熱換算,對應方程式照寫的係數;小蘇打+醋沒有可靠的標準值所以不寫);type 是反應類型、cond 是反應條件;storyTeen / storyHigh 是國中/高中版的說明。

story.zh: 氫氣遇到氧氣再加上一點火花,啪!氫原子和氧原子重新牽手,變成了水。氫氣燃燒後只會產生水,所以是很乾淨的能源。
story.en: Add a spark and hydrogen meets oxygen. Pop! The atoms swap partners and make water. Burning hydrogen only gives water, so it is clean energy.

storyTeen.zh: 氫氣與氧氣在火花引發下反應生成水(2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O)。反應前後原子的種類與數量都不變,只是重新組合;氫氣燃燒只產生水,是潔淨的能源。
storyTeen.en: Hydrogen and oxygen react to form water when ignited (2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O). The kinds and numbers of atoms stay the same; they only rearrange. Burning hydrogen produces only water, so it is a clean fuel.

storyHigh.zh: 氫氣與氧氣經點燃發生放熱的氧化還原反應:H 由 0 價氧化為 +1 價,O 由 0 價還原為 −2 價。產物只有水,所以氫是潔淨的能源載體。
storyHigh.en: Ignited hydrogen and oxygen undergo an exothermic redox reaction: H is oxidized from 0 to +1 and O is reduced from 0 to −2. The only product is water, so hydrogen is a clean energy carrier.

story.zh: 通電後,水分子被拆開,氫原子和氧原子各自重新組合,變成氫氣和氧氣。氫氣的量剛好是氧氣的兩倍!
story.en: Electricity splits water molecules. The atoms regroup into hydrogen and oxygen gas, twice as much hydrogen as oxygen!

storyTeen.zh: 通入直流電時,水被分解成氫氣和氧氣(2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂)。陰極得到的氫氣體積是陽極氧氣的兩倍,和係數比 2:1 相符。
storyTeen.en: Passing a direct current splits water into hydrogen and oxygen (2H₂O → 2H₂ + O₂). The hydrogen collected at the cathode has twice the volume of the oxygen at the anode, matching the 2:1 coefficients.

storyHigh.zh: 電解水是吸熱的氧化還原反應:陰極 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂ + 2OH⁻,陽極 2H₂O → O₂ + 4H⁺ + 4e⁻。氫與氧的體積比為 2:1,反映係數比;純水導電度很低,實驗中常加入少量電解質。
storyHigh.en: Electrolysis of water is an endothermic redox reaction: at the cathode 2H₂O + 2e⁻ → H₂ + 2OH⁻, at the anode 2H₂O → O₂ + 4H⁺ + 4e⁻. The volume ratio of hydrogen to oxygen is 2:1, reflecting the coefficients; pure water conducts poorly, so a little electrolyte is usually added.

story.zh: 煮飯的瓦斯和氧氣一起燃燒,產生二氧化碳和水,同時放出熱量讓食物變熟。
story.en: Cooking gas burns with oxygen, making carbon dioxide and water, and releasing heat to cook food.

storyTeen.zh: 甲烷與氧氣燃燒,生成二氧化碳和水並放出熱(CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O)。左邊 1 個碳、4 個氫、4 個氧,右邊也一樣,原子守恆。
storyTeen.en: Methane burns with oxygen to give carbon dioxide and water and release heat (CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O). The left side has 1 C, 4 H and 4 O, and so does the right: atoms are conserved.

storyHigh.zh: 甲烷完全燃燒是放熱反應,標準燃燒熱約為 −890 kJ/mol:C 由 −4 價氧化為 +4 價,O 被還原。氧氣不足時會生成一氧化碳,有中毒的危險。
storyHigh.en: Complete combustion of methane is exothermic, with a standard enthalpy of combustion of about −890 kJ/mol: C is oxidized from −4 to +4 and O is reduced. With too little oxygen, carbon monoxide forms, which is a poisoning hazard.

story.zh: 一個丙烷分子需要 5 個氧分子才能燒乾淨,變成 3 個二氧化碳和 4 個水。
story.en: One propane needs five oxygen molecules to burn completely, making three CO2 and four water.

storyTeen.zh: 丙烷完全燃燒需要 5 個氧分子,生成 3 個二氧化碳和 4 個水(C₃H₈ + 5O₂ → 3CO₂ + 4H₂O)。配平時先配碳、再配氫,最後配氧。
storyTeen.en: Complete combustion of propane needs 5 oxygen molecules and gives 3 carbon dioxide and 4 water (C₃H₈ + 5O₂ → 3CO₂ + 4H₂O). To balance, do carbon first, then hydrogen, and oxygen last.

storyHigh.zh: 丙烷的標準燃燒熱約為 −2220 kJ/mol,比甲烷多,因為分子含有更多可被氧化的 C–H 與 C–C 鍵。配平的順序通常是先 C、再 H、最後 O。
storyHigh.en: The standard enthalpy of combustion of propane is about −2220 kJ/mol, more than methane because the molecule has more C–H and C–C bonds to oxidize. A usual balancing order is C first, then H, then O.

story.zh: 植物吸收陽光,把二氧化碳和水變成葡萄糖(養分),還送給我們滿滿的氧氣!
story.en: Plants use sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into glucose (food) and give us oxygen!

type.zh: 光合作用(吸熱的氧化還原)

storyTeen.zh: 植物利用光能,把二氧化碳和水變成葡萄糖並釋放氧氣(6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂)。光能被儲存成葡萄糖裡的化學能。
storyTeen.en: Plants use light to turn carbon dioxide and water into glucose and release oxygen (6CO₂ + 6H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂). The light energy is stored as chemical energy in glucose.

storyHigh.zh: 光合作用是吸熱反應,每生成 1 mol 葡萄糖約需吸收 2803 kJ 的能量,由光能提供。光反應產生 ATP 與 NADPH,暗反應(卡爾文循環)再把 CO₂ 固定成糖。
storyHigh.en: Photosynthesis is endothermic: forming 1 mol of glucose takes in about 2803 kJ, supplied by light. The light reactions make ATP and NADPH, and the Calvin cycle then fixes CO₂ into sugar.

story.zh: 鐵遇到空氣中的氧氣,慢慢變成紅褐色的鐵鏽。這個反應很慢,要好幾天甚至好幾年。
story.en: Iron slowly meets oxygen in the air and turns into reddish-brown rust. It takes days or years.

storyTeen.zh: 鐵與空氣中的氧氣及水氣緩慢反應,生成紅褐色的鐵鏽(4Fe + 3O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃)。反應很慢,但會持續讓鐵變脆。
storyTeen.en: Iron reacts slowly with oxygen and moisture in the air to form reddish-brown rust (4Fe + 3O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃). The reaction is slow, but it keeps weakening the iron.

storyHigh.zh: 鐵生鏽是緩慢的氧化還原反應:Fe 由 0 價氧化為 +3 價。實際的鐵鏽是含水的氧化鐵(Fe₂O₃·nH₂O),需要水與氧氣同時存在;反應放熱,但速率很慢。
storyHigh.en: Rusting is a slow redox reaction: Fe is oxidized from 0 to +3. Real rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide (Fe₂O₃·nH₂O) and needs water and oxygen together; the reaction is exothermic but very slow.

name.zh: 小蘇打 + 醋 = 冒泡泡

story.zh: 小蘇打遇到醋就會冒出二氧化碳氣泡,這就是「火山爆發」科學實驗的秘密。
story.en: Baking soda meets vinegar and makes carbon dioxide bubbles: the secret of the volcano experiment.

storyTeen.zh: 碳酸氫鈉(小蘇打)與醋酸反應,生成醋酸鈉、水和二氧化碳氣體(NaHCO₃ + CH₃COOH → CH₃COONa + H₂O + CO₂)。冒出的氣泡就是二氧化碳。
storyTeen.en: Sodium bicarbonate (baking soda) reacts with acetic acid to give sodium acetate, water and carbon dioxide gas (NaHCO₃ + CH₃COOH → CH₃COONa + H₂O + CO₂). The bubbles are carbon dioxide.

storyHigh.zh: 酸鹼反應:醋酸提供 H⁺ 給 HCO₃⁻,生成不穩定的碳酸,隨即分解成 H₂O 與 CO₂ 氣體。這個反應吸熱,混合後溫度會略微下降。
storyHigh.en: An acid–base reaction: acetic acid donates H⁺ to HCO₃⁻, forming unstable carbonic acid that immediately decomposes into H₂O and CO₂ gas. The reaction is endothermic, so the mixture cools slightly.

story.zh: 打雷閃電或紫外線的能量,能把 3 個氧分子重新排成 2 個臭氧分子。雷雨後空氣有種特別的味道,就是臭氧!
story.en: Lightning or UV light can regroup three O2 into two O3. That fresh smell after a thunderstorm is ozone!

storyTeen.zh: 紫外線或閃電的能量可以把 3 個氧分子重新排成 2 個臭氧分子(3O₂ → 2O₃)。雷雨後空氣中特別的味道就是臭氧。
storyTeen.en: The energy of ultraviolet light or lightning can rearrange 3 oxygen molecules into 2 ozone molecules (3O₂ → 2O₃). The fresh smell after a thunderstorm is ozone.

storyHigh.zh: 氧氣在紫外線或放電下形成臭氧(3O₂ → 2O₃),是吸熱反應。臭氧是氧的同素異形體,具有共振結構,中心氧的形式電荷為 +1;在平流層它吸收紫外線,近地面則是汙染物。
storyHigh.en: Under ultraviolet light or an electric discharge oxygen forms ozone (3O₂ → 2O₃), an endothermic reaction. Ozone is an allotrope of oxygen with resonance structures and a formal charge of +1 on the central oxygen; in the stratosphere it absorbs ultraviolet light, while near the ground it is a pollutant.

story.zh: 活潑的鈉和有毒的氯相遇,居然變成每天吃的食鹽!化學變化會讓物質變成完全不一樣的東西。
story.en: Wild sodium meets poisonous chlorine and becomes the salt we eat every day. Chemistry can change things completely!

type.zh: 化合反應(形成離子化合物)

storyTeen.zh: 鈉原子失去 1 個電子成為 Na⁺,氯原子得到 1 個電子成為 Cl⁻,兩者以離子鍵結合成氯化鈉(2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl)。兩種危險的物質變成了日常的食鹽。
storyTeen.en: Each sodium atom loses 1 electron to become Na⁺ and each chlorine atom gains 1 electron to become Cl⁻; they join by ionic bonds to form sodium chloride (2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl). Two dangerous substances become everyday table salt.

storyHigh.zh: 2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl 是劇烈放熱的氧化還原反應,NaCl 的標準生成熱約為 −411 kJ/mol:Na 失去電子被氧化,Cl₂ 得到電子被還原,產物是以離子鍵結合的離子晶體。
storyHigh.en: 2Na + Cl₂ → 2NaCl is a strongly exothermic redox reaction, with a standard enthalpy of formation of NaCl of about −411 kJ/mol: Na loses electrons and is oxidized, Cl₂ gains electrons and is reduced, and the product is an ionic crystal.
